title: The Early Spring (2026)
synopsis:
Shang Zhi Tao, an ordinary graduate, unexpectedly lands a job at one of the world’s top advertising firms and steps into the workplace as a complete rookie. On her very first day, her sharp-tongued boss, Luan Nian, tells her to quit. Undeterred, she endures the pressure, grows through challenges, and eventually proves herself as a capable professional.

Along the way, she falls for Luan Nian—but after six years together, a series of misunderstandings forces her to leave without a word. When they meet again, she has returned to her hometown, running a restaurant and her own small event company, living life on her own terms.

(Source: MyDramaList) 

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zao Chun Qing Lang" (早春晴朗) by Gu Niang Bie Ku (姑娘别哭).
